notices.title: IDENTITY, CREDENTIAL, AND ACCESS MANAGEMENT (ICAM) TRANSITION GUIDANCE: RETIREMENT OF THE LEGACY DD FORM 2875 AND NAVAL IDENTITY SERVICES (NIS) IMPLEMENTATION

judgment.summary: This message directs system managers to move from the manual DD Form 2875 access request to the automated NIS workflow by 30 September 2027.
judgment.audience: Marine Corps FAMs, PMs, and System Owners for NIPRNET systems
judgment.evidence: This message directs the mandatory transition from legacy manual DD Form 2875 SAAR to the NIS automated SAAR workflow service that aligns with DON mandates in references (a) through (c).

notices.title: ADMINISTRATIVE UPDATE TO MARADMIN 189/26 POLICY ON SERVICE EXTENSIONS DURING INVOLUNTARY SEPARATION PROCESSING

judgment.summary: Service extensions are no longer authorized for Marines in involuntary administrative separation processing, and those reaching EAS before processing ends will separate on their scheduled EAS.
judgment.audience: Marines undergoing involuntary administrative separation processing
judgment.depends_on: Only if you are undergoing involuntary administrative separation processing
judgment.evidence: The authority to grant service extensions to Marines undergoing involuntary administrative separation processing under the purview of reference (a) is rescinded.

notices.title: Following major reforms, over 300K new Veterans enroll in VA healthcare in 2026

judgment.evidence: That includes more than 420,000 mental health appointments and more than 16,000 emergency care visits.
judgment.summary: VA reports more than 300,000 new Veterans enrolled in VA healthcare in 2026, along with appointment totals and other service statistics, with no new action required.
